stem.text: An object hangs by means of two cords around two rods, as shown.

stem.alt: Two cords passing over two pulleys fixed to rods, each cord ending in a box with a downward arrow labelled F1 (left) and F2 (right); a grey star-shaped object hangs from the cords at the centre, and the angle θ is marked between the two cords.

stem.text: The object is held in equilibrium by the forces $F_1$ and $F_2$. The object weighs $10\,\text{N}$. There is negligible friction between the rods and cords. Angle $\theta$ is $90^{\circ}$.
Which row of the table gives an angle $\theta$ of $90^{\circ}$?
